scripts.hardhat:setup: npm run hardhat:install && npm run hardhat:init
scripts.deploy: cd blockchain && npx hardhat ignition deploy ./ignition/modules/Lock.ts --reset --network localhost
scripts.deploy:local: cd blockchain && npx hardhat run scripts/deploy.ts --network localhost
scripts.deploy:sepolia: cd blockchain && npx hardhat run scripts/deploy.ts --network sepolia
scripts.deploy:mainnet: cd blockchain && npx hardhat run scripts/deploy.ts --network mainnet
scripts.verify:sepolia: cd blockchain && npx hardhat run scripts/verify.ts --network sepolia
scripts.verify:mainnet: cd blockchain && npx hardhat run scripts/verify.ts --network mainnet
scripts.gas-report: cd blockchain && REPORT_GAS=true npx hardhat test
